_comment: Go-specialist bottom-tier experiment (3:2:1 fan-out). Identical to config.go-specialist-211.json except the fan-out is 3:2:1 — more cheap-tier routing signal and mid-tier repair headroom, at ~50% more cheap-tier spend. Paired with the 2:1:1 config, this maps the cost/routing-signal curve between the winning-but-starved 1:1:1 and the losing default 5:2:1. Llama 4 Maverick prices are the REAL us-west-2 on-demand rates ($0.24/$0.97). test_model=sonnet-4-6 differs from every tier (invariant #3).
